note: Free-scope (no --pair) contract-audit baseline. Each entry individually verified during the 2.9.0 release triage. Pro-scope findings (reads/writes living inside wb-ad-manager-pro) are tracked in the Pro repo's own baseline, not here.

suppressions.reason: FOLLOW-UP (dead hook, pre-existing since <=2.8.1). Links module add_filter('wbam_settings_tabs') is never fired by any apply_filters() in Free or Pro. The legacy filter-based settings page was superseded by the REST settings API; the Links tab definition is orphaned. Link cloaking still works because values are read via Settings_Helper::get() with safe defaults. Decide remove-vs-rewire in a dedicated Links-settings task; not a 2.9.0 regression.

FOLLOW-UP (dead hook, pre-existing since <=2.8.1). Pairs with wbam_settings_tabs above. add_settings_fields() defines link_cloak_prefix / link_default_nofollow / link_default_sponsored / link_default_new_tab against a filter that nothing fires. Field VALUES are consumed via Settings_Helper::get(..., default) so the feature runs on defaults; only the admin UI to change them is missing. Tracked for the Links-settings migration task.

Reads get_option('wbam_currency','USD') as a safe default in Links\class-partnership.php. No global currency setting is wired (per-link payments use the separate 'payment_currency' key). Returns 'USD' until/unless a global setting is added. Minor, pre-existing, no crash.

Intentional, documented opt-in feature flag (class-placement-engine.php). Read with default false and additionally filterable via 'wbam_enforce_format_matching'; sites opt in via update_option or the filter after reviewing backfilled ad formats. By-design read-with-default, not a missing write.

Written by Pro's ad-submission image flow; also a documented historic key variant (_wbam_image_id vs _wbam_ad_image_id, see Pro functions.php wbam_pro_first_post_meta usage).
